issuer: the Bangladesh Road Transport Authority (BRTA), through its circle offices

licence.name: অপেশাদার ড্রাইভিং লাইসেন্স (non-professional driving licence, smart card)

note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Bangladesh Road Transport Authority's site (its page on getting a driving licence, last updated 30 June 2026; the site's certificate chain was completed with the missing intermediate, nothing skipped). A driving licence first needs a learner's licence (Tk 518 for one category, not held); the minimum age is 18 for a non-professional licence (21 for a professional one), with at least class 8 schooling. After passing the competence test, the smart card for a non-professional licence costs Tk 4,497 and lasts 10 years (Tk 60 more for delivery by post, not held). The national identity card is the ids engine's. No exchange list was read.

sources.title: বাংলাদেশ সড়ক পরিবহন কর্তৃপক্ষ (BRTA), ড্রাইভিং লাইসেন্স পাওয়ার প্রক্রিয়া
